messages:
incident-bot: PAGERDUTY: High latency + 5xx spike on /v1/generate (serve-embed-prod). Incident triggered (sev2). svc:runtime, routing:us-west-2. Auto-escalation to oncall.

pagerduty-bot: @Priya (oncall) you were paged: https://pd/company/INC12345 :rotating_light:

Priya (oncall): I'm on it, looking at ingress and runtime metrics. ETA 2m.

Ethan (runtime): I see steady queue growth in the runtime pool for rwd-13b-fp16, avg latency -> 9s, p95 -> 22s, and rising 5xxs from worker OOMs. Likely overcommit + long in-flight streams.

Priya (oncall): Can we drop max_in_flight per worker and enable shedding for non-logged requests?

Ethan (runtime): Yes. Proposing two quick mitigations:
1) set max_in_flight=64 (was 256) for rwd-13b-fp16 on us-west-2
2) enable best-effort shedding flag so that anonymous/low-tier requests get 429s instead of causing queue growth

Priya (oncall): Sounds good. Any one-liners to run?

Ethan (runtime): Running now:
```bash
# reduce inflight
rdctl runtime set-param --region us-west-2 --model rwd-13b-fp16 --param max_in_flight=64 --dry-run=false
# enable shedding policy for route /v1/generate for policy best-effort
rdctl runtime set-policy --region us-west-2 --route /v1/generate --policy shedding:best-effort
```

deploy-bot: rdctl: change applied by ethan@redwood — job 98765 — status: SUCCESS

Ethan (runtime): Applied. I'm also bumping request timeout to 10s for the same model to fail fast on long tails:
```bash
rdctl runtime set-param --region us-west-2 --model rwd-13b-fp16 --param request_timeout_ms=10000
```

Priya (oncall): Noted. Observing metrics now...

Mike (sre): Adding a traffic-shaper cap while we watch — hold overall /v1/generate to 600rps to reduce ingress pressure.

Claire (prod-eng): Which customers will see 429s? We need to notify CS if any paid customers are impacted.

Sophia (cs): Quick check: top 10 customers by QPS in the last hour: AcmeCorp (500rps), BetaApps (120rps), internal-test (40rps). AcmeCorp is on enterprise tier — we should avoid shedding them.

Ethan (runtime): I scoped the shedding rule to "best-effort": anonymous + free-tier + test keys. AcmeCorp (enterprise) excluded.

Priya (oncall): Good. Sophia, can you ping AcmeCorp with a heads-up?

Sophia (cs): On it. Drafting short note: "We're applying temporary mitigation to reduce latency; your enterprise traffic is excluded. Reach out if you see anything." Will send now.

deploy-bot: traffic-shaper: set-rate --route /v1/generate --region us-west-2 --rate 600rps (applied)

Priya (oncall): Latency p95 down from 22s -> 7s over last 2m. Error rate also dropping. 5xxs trending to baseline.

Ethan (runtime): CPU and GPU mem pressure relieving. Suggest follow-ups: add circuit-breaker on long-running streams, tune billing-tier routing to better prioritize enterprise keys, and run a canary rollback test for the model variant.

Mike (sre): Agree. Also recommend increasing per-tenant in-flight cap to enterprise customers only if we later need to re-open capacity. For now keep global lower.

Priya (oncall): I'll hand off to Night oncall. @Eli (oncall-next) you're on deck — please monitor the dashboard for 30m and keep the mitigation in place until we confirm stability.

Eli (oncall-next): Taking over. Thanks team. I'll escalate if we see any regression.

Claire (prod-eng): We'll schedule a root-cause follow-up with Runtime/Infra/Prod in the morning. Action items:
- Runtime: propose long-term defaults for max_in_flight and auto-shedding thresholds
- Infra: add alerts for queue length per-model
- CS: confirm customer outreach (Sophia)

Priya (oncall): Incident downgraded to monitoring. Will file a short incident report and tag for postmortem. Great quick mitigation — thanks everyone :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=monitoring, summary="Applied inflight cap and shedding; latency and 5xx reduced". Postmortem assigned to runtime@redwood.

Priya (oncall): Closing thread for now. Follow-up doc in #postmortems.
